faq.q: Can you buy the Unitree R1?
faq.a: Yes. The Unitree online shop sells the R1 Air, R1 and R1 EDU with checkout prices, and US and EU dealers also stock it.

faq.q: How much does the Unitree R1 cost?
faq.a: On the official Unitree shop the R1 Air is $4,900, the R1 is $5,900 and the R1 EDU is $10,500, before tax, shipping ($300-$1,200) and import duties. US dealers list the R1 Basic at $8,990.

faq.q: Can you program the Unitree R1?
faq.a: Only the EDU version supports secondary development. The R1 Air and R1 are not open for custom programming.

faq.q: Why do US dealers charge more than Unitree?
faq.a: Dealers such as RoboStore sell from US stock with local service. The Unitree shop price excludes shipping, customs duties and import taxes, which the buyer pays.

faq.q: Can you rent a Unitree R1?
faq.a: Yes, for events. Weston Robot lists the R1 at $2,800 per day plus transport, and Futurobots rents it with prices quoted by country.

notes: Unitree also sells a different product, the R1-D, from $4,290 on its shop; it is not the R1 and is not included here. The R1 EDU price differs between unitree.com ('Contact Sales') and the shop ($10,500). Dealer EDU Pro prices depend on the hand option. Shop page lists the R1 at about 29 kg and 123 cm, while launch coverage said 25 kg and 121 cm.
